overzichtModel.query: FROM (SELECT f.*, (select count(b1.betaling_id) from shop_facturen as f1 inner join shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb1 on sfb1.shop_id = f1.shop_id inner join betalingen as b1 on sfb1.betaling_id = b1.betaling_id where f1.shop_id = f.shop_id) as aantal_betalingen, (select sum(b1.bedrag) from shop_facturen as f1 inner join shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb1 on sfb1.shop_id = f1.shop_id inner join betalingen as b1 on sfb1.betaling_id = b1.betaling_id where f1.shop_id = f.shop_id) as totaal_betalingen, (select sum(srp1.product_prijs * srp1.product_aantal) from shop_regel_producten as srp1 where srp1.shop_id = f.shop_id) - (f.korting_bedrag) as totaal_bedrag, sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal) - (f.korting_bedrag) as totaal_bedrag_dubbel, sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal) - (f.korting_bedrag) - (sum(((p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal)) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal))) AS excl_btw, sum(IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0)) - (f.korting_bedrag) - (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),1)))) AS excl_btw_hoog, sum(IF(p.product_btw = 6 OR p.product_btw = 9,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0)) - (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 6 OR p.product_btw = 9,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) AS excl_btw_laag, sum(IF(p.product_btw = 0,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0)) - (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 0,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) AS excl_btw_nul, (sum(((p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal)) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal))) AS btw, (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) AS btw_hoog, (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 6 OR p.product_btw = 9,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) AS btw_laag, (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 0,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) AS btw_nul FROM (SELECT f.*, b.betaling_id FROM shop_facturen AS f JOIN shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb ON f.shop_id = sfb.shop_id JOIN betalingen AS b ON sfb.betaling_id = b.betaling_id :f.where) AS f INNER JOIN shop_regel_producten AS p ON f.shop_id = p.shop_id GROUP BY f.shop_id, f.betaling_id) AS f JOIN shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb ON f.shop_id = sfb.shop_id JOIN betalingen AS b ON sfb.betaling_id = b.betaling_id and f.betaling_id = b.betaling_id LEFT JOIN klanten AS k ON f.klant_id = k.klant_id
